data.alternatives: Rewrite old shards (violates r-replay-compat); keep only last renewal (loses evidence); database/external store (r-log-is-the-state); new summary kind (old readers see leases expire).
data.consequences: Repo size unchanged; liveness resolution = summary cadence (600 s, <= ttl/2); old readers stay correct since summaries are renewals; gate.started/out_of_order need counted summaries (phase 2).
data.context: Operator 2026-11-03: keep every event, parallel agents in many clones, nothing lost. D-scale-answers (3)(4); R-scalability.
data.decision: Tier lease.renewed first: every renewal goes to a per-agent committed cold shard (.ddflow/cold/), the hot shard gets a coarse summary that is itself a lease.renewed carrying a ref (shard,start,end,sha256,count). The full log is the union of hot and cold shards ordered (lamport,id); replay, export, verify, correction and --full fold read the union. ddflow.seen stays hot; gate.started/out_of_order are phase 2 after measurement. Default tier.enabled=false, forward-only, rollback by config; search falls through summary to cold range bounded, reporting unavailable/truncated. Measured: hot events -19.5 percent, bytes -4.7 percent; the State checkpoint remains the main speed win.
data.title: Hot/cold tiering: cold per-agent shards plus compatible lease.renewed summaries with (shard,start,end,sha256) refs
